description: Suggest a real venue for DrinkedIn to check later. Send name, latitude, and longitude. Address, phone, website, hours, category, name_he, and social_urls are optional. This does not validate the venue, does not say it is open, and does not overwrite a validated field. With venue creation enabled, a new name within about 150 metres of no existing bar is stored as an unvalidated bar and is not for resale. A folded or phonetic name match in that circle attaches the hints to the existing bar. Two matches are reported and not written. A directory or review URL is dropped and is not evidence. The normal validation check may later confirm the venue from its own website or own social page. With creation disabled, the suggestion is queued and no bar is inserted. Each call records a queue row. Nothing is booked or ordered. Success returns suggestion_id and, when creation is enabled, listing. For a night out from validated venues, call drinkedin_plan_evening. For people of legal drinking age where they are.

category.description: Optional short label. Defaults to bar.

hours.description: Optional hours as text or a JSON object. Not an open/closed claim.

name_he.description: Optional Hebrew name. Stored as another spelling.

phone.description: Optional venue phone. Not the caller's phone.

social_urls.description: Optional own social page URLs. Directory hosts are dropped.

website.description: Optional venue website. A directory URL is dropped.

name: drinkedin_suggest_venue

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.
